description.zh: 国泰海通智能助手：金融数据、实时行情、灵犀智能选股、灵犀自选股管理、研报搜索、灵犀市场热榜查询——依托国泰海通专业金融能力，一站式对话服务投资研究与交易决策。
description.en: Guotai Haitong AI assistant: financial data, real-time quotes, Lingxi smart stock screening, Lingxi watchlist management, research report search, and Lingxi market hot-list queries — one-stop conversational access to professional capabilities for research and trading decisions.

welcome_message.zh: 你好，我是国泰海通 AI 助手——金融数据、实时行情、灵犀智能选股、研报搜索、市场热榜，专业能力对话即达。今天想从哪里开始？
welcome_message.en: Hi, I'm the Guotai Haitong AI assistant — financial data, real-time quotes, Lingxi smart screening, research search, and market hot lists, all conversational. Where shall we start?

description.zh: 指数与个股实时行情一问即达

prompt.zh: 请查询上证指数、深证成指、创业板指的实时行情，以及最近涨幅居前的个股。
prompt.en: Fetch real-time quotes for the SSE, SZSE, and ChiNext indices, plus recently leading stocks.

description.zh: 按条件智能筛选候选标的

prompt.zh: 请用灵犀智能选股帮我筛选：市值 100 亿以上、近 20 日涨幅超过 10%、成交量放大的个股，列出名单与关键数据。
prompt.en: Use Lingxi smart screening: market cap over 10B, 20-day gain over 10%, expanding volume — list candidates with key data.

description.zh: 按主题检索最新研报观点

prompt.zh: 请搜索最近一周关于人工智能产业的券商研报，列出标题、券商、评级与核心观点。
prompt.en: Search last week's AI-industry broker reports: title, broker, rating, and core views.

description.zh: 热股/热榜一屏掌握市场焦点

prompt.zh: 请查询今天的市场热榜：热门个股、热门板块与讨论焦点。
prompt.en: Fetch today's market hot list: trending stocks, sectors, and discussion focus.
